source.paper: Bukvisova, Kalousek, Patocka, Zlamal, Planer, Mahel, Citterberg, Novak, Sikola, Kolibal 2025, Casimir-like effect driven self-assembly of graphene on molten metals, arXiv:2503.04327 (preprint; journal version not verified)
source.figure: Fig. S1D (Supporting Information: Raman spectra of graphene grown on Au and Cu, after rapid cooling to room temperature)

notes: WEAK CASE. The paper only states that the layers are graphene (confirmed by Raman), that the D peak is higher on Au than on Cu, laser power 0.2 mW and grating 2400 g/mm. Layer number, laser wavelength and peak positions are NOT stated in the paper: peak positions in this key were read from the data by the curator (D, G, 2D local maxima) and are not the authors' values. Laser wavelength is unknown (the 2D position suggests 532 nm, unverified). Spectrum is raw CCD counts including a broad background; x axis runs from about -105 to 3650 cm-1.
